import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototypes
cdf_gumbel2_P = gsl.gsl_cdf_gumbel2_P
cdf_gumbel2_P.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
cdf_gumbel2_P.restype = ctypes.c_double

cdf_gumbel2_Q = gsl.gsl_cdf_gumbel2_Q
cdf_gumbel2_Q.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
cdf_gumbel2_Q.restype = ctypes.c_double


def gumbel2_cdf_ccdf(x, a, b):
    """Compute the CDF and CCDF for the Gumbel Type-II distribution."""
    cdf = cdf_gumbel2_P(x, a, b)
    ccdf = cdf_gumbel2_Q(x, a, b)
    return cdf, ccdf


def assert_test():
    """Test cases for gumbel2_cdf_ccdf function."""
    # Test case 1: x = 0, a = 1, b = 1
    cdf, ccdf = gumbel2_cdf_ccdf(0.0, 1.0, 1.0)
    assert cdf == 0.0, f"Expected CDF 0.0, got {cdf}"
    assert ccdf == 1.0, f"Expected CCDF 1.0, got {ccdf}"

    # Test case 2: x = 1, a = 1, b = 1
    cdf, ccdf = gumbel2_cdf_ccdf(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)
    assert abs(cdf - 0.36787944117144233) < 1e-9, f"Expected CDF ~0.36787944117144233, got {cdf}"
    assert abs(ccdf - 0.6321205588285577) < 1e-9, f"Expected CCDF ~0.6321205588285577, got {ccdf}"

    # Test case 3: x = 2, a = 2, b = 2
    cdf, ccdf = gumbel2_cdf_ccdf(2.0, 2.0, 2.0)
    assert abs(cdf - 0.6065306597126334) < 1e-9, f"Expected CDF ~0.6065306597126334, got {cdf}"
    assert abs(ccdf - 0.3934693402873666) < 1e-9, f"Expected CCDF ~0.3934693402873666, got {ccdf}"

    assert_test()
